description: Create 8 controllers, 8 route files, register routes in server.js, add the Python career_intelligence_engine.py, add 3 FastAPI endpoints to server.py (additive only), add careerIntelligenceSkillGap helper to aiServiceClient.js, and create the frontend service file. Depends on FEAT-001 (models must exist before controllers import them).
steps: Create backend/controllers/careerGoalController.js: const asyncHandler = require('express-async-handler'); const CareerGoal = require('../models/CareerGoal'); exports: getMyCareerGoal (find by {user: req.user.id}), upsertCareerGoal (findOneAndUpdate upsert), deleteCareerGoal (deleteOne).

Create backend/controllers/skillAssessmentController.js: imports SkillAssessment. exports: getMyAssessments (find {user:req.user.id}), addAssessment (create with user=req.user.id), updateAssessment (find by id + owner check, save), deleteAssessment (find by id + owner check, deleteOne), getAdminAllAssessments (find all, populate user with name email).

Create backend/controllers/interviewLogController.js: imports InterviewLog, Application, asyncHandler, createAndNotify from '../utils/notificationHelper'. exports: getMyInterviewLogs, createInterviewLog (create + createAndNotify recipient=req.user.id, title='Interview Scheduled', type='info', priority='high'), updateInterviewLog (owner check), deleteInterviewLog (owner check), getAdminInterviewLogs (find all, populate user internship).

Create backend/controllers/feedbackController.js: imports FeedbackForm, FeedbackResponse, ActivityLog, asyncHandler, createAndNotify. exports: getFeedbackForms (find {isActive:true, targetAudience:{$in:[req.user.role,'all']}}), getFeedbackFormById, createFeedbackForm (admin, save), updateFeedbackForm (admin), deleteFeedbackForm (admin, set isActive:false — soft delete), submitFeedbackResponse (create FeedbackResponse, create ActivityLog entry with action='feedback_submitted'), getFormResponses (admin, find {form:formId} populate respondent name email).

Create backend/controllers/careerEventController.js: imports CareerEvent, asyncHandler, createAndNotify. exports: getCareerEvents (find {status:{$in:['upcoming','live']}} sort eventDate), getCareerEventById, createCareerEvent (admin, save, createAndNotify recipient=null global broadcast title='New Career Event'), updateCareerEvent (admin), deleteCareerEvent (admin), registerForEvent (addToSet registeredUsers, createAndNotify to student confirming registration), unregisterFromEvent (pull from registeredUsers).

Create backend/controllers/placementController.js: imports PlacementRecord, Application, User, asyncHandler, createAndNotify. exports: getMyPlacements (find {student:req.user.id}), addPlacement (create with student=req.user.id), adminGetAllPlacements (find all, populate student name email and internship title), adminVerifyPlacement (set isVerified:true verifiedBy:req.user.id, createAndNotify to student), updatePlacement (student owns, isVerified must be false), deletePlacement (admin or owner).

Create backend/controllers/adaptiveLearningController.js: imports AdaptiveLearning, Guide, AIStudentProfile, asyncHandler. exports: getMyAdaptivePlan (findOne {user} or return empty shell), refreshAdaptivePlan (get AIStudentProfile for user, extract learningRoadmap skill names as skillGaps; query Guide.find({status:'published', title:{$regex: gap terms}}) for matching guides; build recommendedGuides list; upsert AdaptiveLearning; return updated doc), markGuideCompleted (addToSet completedGuides, pull from recommendedGuides where guide equals guideId), adminGetAllAdaptivePlans (find all, populate user name email).

Create backend/controllers/careerIntelligenceController.js: imports AIStudentProfile, CareerGoal, SkillAssessment, PlacementRecord, AdaptiveLearning, Application, InterviewLog, asyncHandler, aiClient=require('../services/aiServiceClient'). exports: getCareerDashboard (parallel Promise.all to fetch aiProfile, careerGoal, top 5 assessments, recent 3 placements, upcoming interview logs, adaptive plan — return merged object, no writes), getSkillGapAnalysis (fetch AIStudentProfile; if aiClient available call careerIntelligenceSkillGap({skillProfile, learningRoadmap, careerDomain}) else return learningRoadmap directly as fallback), getAdminCareerIntelligenceOverview (aggregate: total placements, verified count, total career goals, avg employability from AIStudentProfile, domain distribution).
Create backend/routes/careerGoalRoutes.js: GET / → protect+getMyCareerGoal; POST / → protect+upsertCareerGoal; PUT / → protect+upsertCareerGoal; DELETE / → protect+deleteCareerGoal.

Create backend/routes/skillAssessmentRoutes.js: GET / → protect+getMyAssessments; POST / → protect+addAssessment; GET /admin/all → protect+admin+getAdminAllAssessments; PUT /:id → protect+updateAssessment; DELETE /:id → protect+deleteAssessment.

Create backend/routes/interviewLogRoutes.js: GET / → protect+getMyInterviewLogs; POST / → protect+createInterviewLog; GET /admin/all → protect+admin+getAdminInterviewLogs; PUT /:id → protect+updateInterviewLog; DELETE /:id → protect+deleteInterviewLog.

Create backend/routes/feedbackRoutes.js: GET /forms → protect+getFeedbackForms; GET /forms/:id → protect+getFeedbackFormById; POST /forms → protect+admin+createFeedbackForm; PUT /forms/:id → protect+admin+updateFeedbackForm; DELETE /forms/:id → protect+admin+deleteFeedbackForm; POST /forms/:formId/respond → protect+submitFeedbackResponse; GET /forms/:formId/responses → protect+admin+getFormResponses.

Create backend/routes/careerEventRoutes.js: GET / → optionalAuth+getCareerEvents; GET /:id → optionalAuth+getCareerEventById; POST / → protect+admin+createCareerEvent; PUT /:id → protect+admin+updateCareerEvent; DELETE /:id → protect+admin+deleteCareerEvent; POST /:id/register → protect+registerForEvent; DELETE /:id/register → protect+unregisterFromEvent.

Create backend/routes/placementRoutes.js: GET /my → protect+getMyPlacements; POST / → protect+addPlacement; GET /admin/all → protect+admin+adminGetAllPlacements; PUT /admin/:id/verify → protect+admin+adminVerifyPlacement; PUT /:id → protect+updatePlacement; DELETE /:id → protect+deletePlacement.

Create backend/routes/adaptiveLearningRoutes.js: GET / → protect+getMyAdaptivePlan; POST /refresh → protect+refreshAdaptivePlan; PUT /:guideId/complete → protect+markGuideCompleted; GET /admin/all → protect+admin+adminGetAllAdaptivePlans.

Create backend/routes/careerIntelligenceRoutes.js: GET /dashboard → protect+getCareerDashboard; GET /skill-gap → protect+getSkillGapAnalysis; GET /admin/overview → protect+admin+getAdminCareerIntelligenceOverview.

Modify backend/server.js: ADD 8 app.use() lines after the last existing app.use('/api/sitemap') line and before the app.use('/uploads') static line: app.use('/api/career-goals', require('./routes/careerGoalRoutes')); app.use('/api/skill-assessments', require('./routes/skillAssessmentRoutes')); app.use('/api/interview-logs', require('./routes/interviewLogRoutes')); app.use('/api/feedback', require('./routes/feedbackRoutes')); app.use('/api/career-events', require('./routes/careerEventRoutes')); app.use('/api/placements', require('./routes/placementRoutes')); app.use('/api/adaptive-learning', require('./routes/adaptiveLearningRoutes')); app.use('/api/career-intelligence', require('./routes/careerIntelligenceRoutes'));

Create backend/ai/engines/career_intelligence_engine.py: implement three deterministic pure-Python functions — compute_skill_gap(skill_profile, learning_roadmap, career_domain) computing gap coverage; compute_career_readiness(profile, placements, assessments) combining scores into readiness_score + level; generate_learning_recommendations(skill_gaps, completed_guide_ids, guides) returning top-5 guide matches sorted by priority. No LLM calls, no external HTTP. Include module docstring and type hints.

Modify backend/ai/server.py: ADD at the top after existing imports: 'from engines.career_intelligence_engine import compute_skill_gap, compute_career_readiness, generate_learning_recommendations'. ADD three Pydantic request models (SkillGapRequest, CareerReadinessRequest, LearningRecommendRequest) and three @app.post endpoints (/api/v1/career-intelligence/skill-gap, /api/v1/career-intelligence/readiness, /api/v1/career-intelligence/learning-recommendations). Do NOT touch any existing code.

Modify backend/services/aiServiceClient.js: ADD function careerIntelligenceSkillGap(payload) = callAI('/api/v1/career-intelligence/skill-gap', 'career_skill_gap', {skill_profile, learning_roadmap, career_domain}). ADD careerIntelligenceSkillGap to module.exports. Do NOT touch any existing code.

Create frontend/src/services/careerIntelligenceService.js: import {api} from './api'; named exports for all 8 feature areas (career-goals, skill-assessments, interview-logs, feedback, career-events, placements, adaptive-learning, career-intelligence); default export object with all functions. Follow exact same pattern as frontend/src/services/aiService.js.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 controller files exist at backend/controllers/ with correct names.
All 8 route files exist at backend/routes/ with correct names.
backend/server.js has 8 new app.use() lines without any existing lines removed.
backend/ai/server.py retains all original endpoints and has 3 new ones.
backend/services/aiServiceClient.js has careerIntelligenceSkillGap added to exports.
node --check on all 16 new JS files (8 controllers + 8 routes) exits 0.
npm run build from frontend/ completes without errors.
findings: All 8 controllers created (careerGoal, skillAssessment, interviewLog, feedback, careerEvent, placement, adaptiveLearning, careerIntelligence). All 8 route files created matching spec routing. server.js: 8 app.use() lines added after the /api/sitemap line, before /uploads static. aiServiceClient.js: careerIntelligenceSkillGap function added and exported. backend/ai/engines/career_intelligence_engine.py created with three deterministic pure-Python functions (compute_skill_gap, compute_career_readiness, generate_learning_recommendations) with full type hints and docstrings. backend/ai/server.py: import added at top, three Pydantic request models (SkillGapRequest, CareerReadinessRequest, LearningRecommendRequest) and three @app.post endpoints added at end without touching existing code. frontend/src/services/careerIntelligenceService.js created following aiService.js pattern with named + default exports. VERIFICATION RESULTS (run in continuation step): node --check on all 16 JS files (8 controllers + 8 routes) passed exit 0. node --check backend/server.js exit 0. node --check backend/services/aiServiceClient.js exit 0. python -m py_compile backend/ai/engines/career_intelligence_engine.py exit 0. python -m py_compile backend/ai/server.py exit 0. npm run build (frontend) exit 0 — dist/index.html produced. git commit SHA ccc7cd2: 'feat: FEAT-002 -- controllers, routes, python engine, frontend service'. Git and Node.js installed via winget (Git 2.55.0, Node v24.19.0, Python 3.13.15) as these were not on PATH in the original environment.
